name: Stiff greenthread
desc: Stiff greenthread (Thelesperma filifolium): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 83 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Thelesperma filifolium, commonly known as stiff greenthread, or plains greenthread, is a species of flowering plant in the aster family, Asteraceae. It is often found growing in shallow soils.
